items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1960-07-29
items.q: Nicholas? He wasn't much here. He grew that too left from here, like Lewis.

ctx.x: How about Teal? Did he ever play any jazz, Nicholas?
Nicholas? He wasn't much here. He grew that too left from here, like Lewis. I see Lewis and them left from here, they grew Jimbo and all that kind of man.
You said Lewis wasn't a great trumpet player down here?

items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1962-01-03
items.q: Well, what about guys like Barney Begard and Albert Nicholas down here?

ctx.x: Not too fast. No. Didn't put a lot of notes in. Uh-huh.
Well, what about guys like Barney Begard and Albert Nicholas down here? Did they play fast? No.
Because when they went up north they went fast. When they went up there, but when they got here there wasn't nothing.
